何雨柱风风火火的进了院子，直奔贾家。王野见这有大戏可以看，这哪能错过呀，领着何雨水就跟了上去。王野刚进中院，就听见何雨柱和贾张氏已经开骂了。

王野就听了一会儿就觉得国粹呀，真是国粹呀，这东西不论年代的，就是在后世，也不一定有人是这里俩人的对手。那真是上到祖宗十八代，下到人体器官，无所不用其极。

就在王野看得正热闹时，贾东旭出来了。他似乎觉得自己老娘要吃亏，所以出来帮忙了：“傻柱你还有没有教养呀，怎么能这么跟老家儿骂街呀。”

王野一听，心想：“我去！这贾东旭可以呀！不愧是易中海的徒弟，一张嘴就要占领道德高地。”

何雨柱被这一句直接问愣了，在这个院子里，易中海的尊老敬老的思想已经开始有了影响了。眼看何雨柱要落下风，王野哪能看着呀。这时不出嘴更待何时：“贾张氏姓张，何雨柱姓何，怎么论俩人也没亲戚关系，怎么就是何雨柱的老家儿了？”

何雨柱一听王野的话立刻来劲了：“对呀！你娘这老太婆和我有什么关系呀？跟我充什么大辈儿呀？就你娘这猪一样的身材，也不是我何家能养的出来的呀！”

贾东旭一听见王野说话，就看了过来，他也没有继续跟何雨柱对线，调转炮口对上了王野：“你谁呀？跟你有关系吗？”

王野刚要说话，何雨柱就拦在了两人中间：“这是谁你不认识呀，我兄弟王野，怎么滴，不服呀？都不用我兄弟出手，我就能摆平你！”

“傻柱，你别嚣张，你不就能打个许大茂吗，还真当是咱们院的战神了呀？不行咱们练练，谁趴下还不一定呢！”

院里看热闹的众人见要动手了，纷纷向后退留出足够的空间。贾东旭平时也经常和街里的小混混一起玩，平时街面上也总是打架。跟院里的许大茂也动过手，虽然不轻松但也是赢了。而跟何雨柱因为易中海的原因还就真没动过手。这也给了贾东旭很大的信心。

刚一摆开架势，贾东旭就挥着拳头冲向何雨柱。何雨柱可不是挥拳迎击，而是摆开了一个摔跤的架势，他身形一闪，瞬间贴近对手，双手紧紧抓住贾东旭的手臂，猛地一用力，将贾东旭拉向自己。

贾东旭失去平衡，身体向前倾倒，何雨柱顺势一个转身，将贾东旭扛在肩上。接着，腰部用力一扭，双手向下一甩，贾东旭便被重重地摔在地上。

整个过程干净利落，王野不禁为何雨柱的身手叫好。大院战神不愧战神二字呀，手底下是真有两下子。何雨柱得势不饶人，顺势就骑在贾东旭身上，沙包那么大的拳头雨点般的落了下来。

就在这时，易中海从人群后面挤了进来，张嘴喝道：“傻柱，住手！”

何雨柱下意识的停下了拳头，回头看见易中海张嘴就要开骂。王野可是知道何雨柱要骂什么，紧忙上前一步捂住何雨柱的嘴，把他从贾东旭身上拉了起来。

贾东旭看见易中海来了，赶紧上前：“师傅啊，你看傻柱给我打的呀！你可得帮我讨回公道啊！”

看贾东旭的样子，活像那在外面吃了亏的孩子。

“傻柱，不论怎么说，你和东旭都是一个院里长大的，怎么能下这么重的手呢？”

何雨柱听见这话，要是以前可能会心不甘情不愿听着，但是知道了易中海这些年的所作所为，哪能还忍着呀？拉开架势就要上前。

王野可不能让他上去瞎说，这要是说了什么不该说的，何大清的谋划都得打水漂，一把拉回何雨柱，上前一步说：“易大爷，话可不能这么说，不能因为你是贾东旭的师傅，你就偏袒他呀？你还是这个院里的一大爷，街道里是信任你，才委任你当这一大爷。你要是不能公平公正的解决问题，怎么对得起街道的信任呀？”

He Yuzhu entered the courtyard in a hurry and went straight to Jia's house.Wang Ye saw that there was a big show to watch and how could he miss it, so he led He Yueyue and followed him.As soon as Wang Ye entered the middle courtyard, he heard that He Yuzhu and Jia Zhang were already scolding each other.

After listening to it for a while, Wang Ye felt that it was the quintessence of the country. It was really the quintessence of the country. Regardless of age, even in later generations, there might not be anyone who could be the opponent of the two here.That is really from eighteen generations of ancestors down to human organs, everything is used to the extreme.

Just when Wang Ye was watching the excitement, Jia Dongxu came out.He seemed to feel that his mother was going to suffer, so he came out to help: "Sinzhu, do you have any education? How can you scold me like this?"

When Wang Ye heard this, he thought to himself: "I'll go! This Jia Dongxu can do it! He is worthy of being Yi Zhonghai's disciple. He will occupy the moral high ground with just one mouth."

He Yuzhu was stunned by this direct question. In this courtyard, Yi Zhonghai's idea of respecting the elderly has begun to have an impact.Seeing that He Yuzhu was about to fall, how could Wang Ye watch.Why don't you say anything at this time: "Jia Zhang's surname is Zhang, and He Yuzhu's surname is He. They are not related to each other. How come they are He Yuzhu's hometown?"

He Yuzhu immediately became excited when he heard Wang Ye's words: "Yes! What does your mother, an old woman, have to do with me? Why do you act like a senior to me? Your mother has a figure like a pig, and my He family cannot raise her!"

As soon as Jia Dongxu heard Wang Ye speak, he looked over. He did not continue to confront He Yuzhu, but turned his gun to face Wang Ye: "Who are you? Does it have anything to do with you?"

Just as Wang Ye was about to speak, He Yuzhu stopped between the two of them: "You don't know who this is? My brother Wang Ye, why don't you accept it? I can deal with you without my brother taking action!"

"Silly Zhu, don't be arrogant. Can't you beat Xu Damao? You really think he is the God of War in our academy? If not, let's practice. We don't know who will get down!"

Seeing that he was about to take action, everyone watching the excitement in the courtyard stepped back to leave enough space.Jia Dongxu often plays with the gangsters in the street, and there are always fights on the street.I also fought against Xu Damao in the courtyard. Although it was not easy, I won.But he and He Yuzhu really didn't do anything because of Yi Zhonghai.This also gave Jia Dongxu great confidence.

As soon as he got into his stance, Jia Dongxu rushed towards He Yuzhu with his fists waving.He Yuzhu did not punch to meet the attack, but took a wrestling stance. He flashed and got close to his opponent in an instant. He grabbed Jia Dongxu's arm tightly with both hands and pulled Jia Dongxu towards him with a sudden force.

Jia Dongxu lost his balance and fell forward. He Yuzhu turned around and carried Jia Dongxu on his shoulders.Then, he twisted his waist hard and threw his hands down, and Jia Dongxu was thrown heavily to the ground.

The whole process was neat and tidy, and Wang Ye couldn't help but praise why Yuzhu's skills.The God of War in the courtyard is worthy of the title of God of War. He really has two tricks in his hands.He Yuzhu was unyielding and took advantage of the situation to ride on Jia Dongxu, and fists as big as sandbags rained down.

At this moment, Yi Zhonghai squeezed in from behind the crowd, opened his mouth and shouted: "Silly Zhu, stop!"

He Yuzhu stopped his fist subconsciously and turned around to see Yi Zhonghai opening his mouth to curse.Wang Ye knew what He Yuzhu was going to scold, so he hurriedly stepped forward and covered He Yuzhu's mouth, pulling him up from Jia Dongxu.

When Jia Dongxu saw Yi Zhonghai coming, he hurriedly stepped forward: "Master, look what Silly Zhu beat me up! You have to help me seek justice!"

Looking at Jia Dongxu, he looks like a child who suffered a loss outside.

"Silly Zhu, no matter what, you and Dongxu grew up in the same courtyard, how could you do such a heavy hand?"

When He Yuzhu heard this, he might have been reluctant to listen before, but after knowing what Yi Zhonghai has done over the years, how could he still endure it?Get ready and step forward.

Wang Ye couldn't let him go up and talk nonsense. If he said something that shouldn't be said, He Daqing's plan would be ruined. He pulled He Yuzhu back and stepped forward and said, "Uncle Yi, you can't say that. Just because you are Jia Dongxu's master, you can't favor him? You are still the master of this courtyard, and the streets trust you, so they appointed you as this master. If you can't solve the problem fairly and justly, how can you deserve the trust of the streets?"
